{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'

print(f'Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = sales['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}')

sentinel_mask = sales['customer_age'] == -1
print(f'Number of sentinel age values (-1): {sentinel_mask.sum()}')

# Check data types
types_check = sales.dtypes
print(types_check)

# Inspect revenue column
revenue_examples = sales['revenue'].head(10)
print('\nRevenue examples (first 10):')
print(revenue_examples)"}
